pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the sherox toolkit: what it does, its three CLI tools (sherox.asr, sherox.segment, sherox.tts), supported models, and how the major subsystems relate. Links to child pages for setup and architecture details.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation, dependencies, Python version requirements, and first-run examples for each CLI tool. Covers model auto-download behaviour and the models/ directory layout.

pages.title: CLI Reference
pages.purpose: Detailed reference for all four CLI entry points: sherox.asr, sherox.segment, sherox.tts, and sherox.sid. Covers every flag, its default value, and usage examples drawn from the module docstrings.

pages.title: Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of how the sherox package is structured: the separation between configuration, engine factory, audio I/O, streaming loops, and CLI entry points. Links to child pages for each subsystem.

pages.title: Configuration System
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the three dataclasses (Config, SegmentConfig, TtsConfig) defined in sherox/config.py. Explains every field, its default, and how CLI arguments override defaults at runtime.

pages.title: ASR Engine Factory
pages.purpose: Explains sherox/asr_engine.py: the build_recognizer, build_offline_recognizer, build_vad, and build_diarization factory functions. Covers model-type routing, the _find glob helper, endpoint detection rules, and VAD configuration lifecycle.

pages.title: Audio Ingestion
pages.purpose: Documents sherox/audio.py: the read_wav generator and mic_stream generator. Covers chunk-based streaming, mono/float32 constraints, queue-based callback architecture for microphone capture, and sample-rate requirements.

pages.title: Streaming and Offline Processing Loops
pages.purpose: Explains sherox/streaming.py: run_streaming (online loop with partial hypotheses and endpoint detection) and run_offline_vad_streaming (VAD-segmented offline loop). Covers concurrent diarization via ThreadPoolExecutor, speaker colour palettes, and terminal rendering with rich.

pages.title: ASR Pipelines
pages.purpose: Overview of the two ASR execution modes (online streaming and offline VAD-segmented) and the supported model architectures. Links to child pages for each pipeline.

pages.title: Online Streaming Pipeline
pages.purpose: Detailed walkthrough of the online (streaming) ASR pipeline: how audio chunks flow from mic_stream/read_wav into OnlineRecognizer, partial hypothesis display, endpoint detection rules (rule1/rule2/rule3), stream reset, and optional concurrent diarization.

pages.title: Offline VAD-Segmented Pipeline
pages.purpose: Detailed walkthrough of the offline pipeline: VAD accumulates audio until silence, then the full segment is sent to OfflineRecognizer. Covers Silero vs Ten-VAD selection, VAD parameters, and how offline-only model types (Whisper, NeMo, SenseVoice, Moonshine, FireRedASR) are auto-detected.

pages.title: Speaker Diarization
pages.purpose: Explains the optional diarization feature: build_diarization factory, pyannote segmentation model, NeMo speaker embedding extractor, FastClustering, concurrent execution with ASR, dominant-speaker selection, and colour-coded terminal output.

pages.title: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
pages.purpose: Overview and deep dive into sherox/tts.py: the sherox.tts CLI, TtsConfig, build_tts factory, synthesise function, model registry, auto-download, and playback via sounddevice.

pages.title: TTS Engine and Model Registry
pages.purpose: Details the _TTS_MODELS registry (ISO 639-3 → model metadata), the build_tts factory that constructs sherpa_onnx.OfflineTts, the _ensure_model download/extraction flow, and the synthesise function that returns float32 PCM samples.

pages.title: TTS CLI and Output Handling
pages.purpose: Documents the sherox.tts CLI: text input modes (--text, --file, stdin), language selection, speed control, speaker ID for multi-speaker models, WAV file output via soundfile, and live playback via sounddevice.

pages.title: VAD Segmentation Tool
pages.purpose: Overview and deep dive into sherox/segment.py: the sherox.segment CLI, SegmentConfig, run_segment loop, timestamp formatting, optional WAV segment saving, and VAD model auto-download.

pages.title: VAD Model Configuration
pages.purpose: Explains the two supported VAD backends (Silero and Ten-VAD), their ONNX model files, configuration parameters (threshold, min_silence_duration, min_speech_duration), and how build_vad constructs the VoiceActivityDetector.

pages.title: Segment Loop and Output
pages.purpose: Documents the run_segment function: chunk consumption, vad.accept_waveform, segment extraction from vad.front, timestamp formatting, optional WAV file saving per segment, mic-level RMS bar, and flush-on-exit behaviour.

pages.title: Benchmarking Framework
pages.purpose: Overview of the benchmark/ directory: purpose, CLI, and how it ties together the ASR engine, metrics, and LibriSpeech data. Links to child pages for the benchmark runner and metrics system.

pages.title: Benchmark Runner
pages.purpose: Deep dive into benchmark/benchmark.py: CLI flags, run_benchmark loop, manifest_from_librispeech crawler, load_audio preprocessing, transcribe_offline and transcribe_online functions, streaming simulation with chunk feeding and endpoint detection, and error-resilient execution.

pages.title: Metrics: WER, RTF, and Composite Score
pages.purpose: Documents benchmark/metrics.py: normalize_text, UtteranceResult dataclass and its compute() method, AggregateMetrics with corpus-level WER/RTF/latency/composite_score properties, and the editdistance-based Levenshtein calculation.

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of the tests/ directory: test package structure, conftest.py path injection, and the coverage of each test module. Links to child pages for unit tests and test patterns.

pages.title: Unit Tests: Audio, Config, and ASR Engine
pages.purpose: Covers test_audio.py (mock-based tests for read_wav and mic_stream), test_config.py (Config/SegmentConfig/TtsConfig validation), and test_asr_engine.py (factory function tests with mocked sherpa-onnx, model-type routing, VAD config lifecycle).

pages.title: Unit Tests: Streaming, ASR CLI, and Benchmark
pages.purpose: Covers test_streaming.py (run_streaming and run_offline_vad_streaming with mocked recognizers), test_asr.py (sherox.asr CLI integration tests), test_benchmark.py (manifest parsing, transcribe_online endpoint assembly), and test_benchmark_metrics.py (WER/RTF calculations).

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, model names, and domain concepts that an onboarding engineer needs to know. Each entry includes file/class/function pointers.
